title: Bar Leivai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Niddah] 40a: “Bar Levai taught.” In Zevachim 115a: “When Rav Dimi came, he said: A Tanna of the school of Bar Leivai taught.” In Shabbat 108b, Bar Leivai was standing before Mar Ukva, etc. Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi is also called Bar Leivai, as explained in his entry.

notes.text: The supplied work token is בגדה. Niddah 40a contains the matching תני בר לוואי passage; the correction is displayed in brackets and does not alter the frozen Hebrew.
